notes: Fixture intent (fixture mission/run ids, not Mission Control ids). Gaps in biotech-knowledge-intent.v1 for D9 (also in 08-sources-and-tools.md): (1) no proposal kind writes a claim occurrence with HAS_OBJECT, OCCURRENCE_OF and OCCURS_IN; occurrences are assertion.literal (subject, predicate, speechAct, asserter, value) and the object / container / DERIVED_FROM links are in assertions.yaml only; (2) a declared source ref cannot be an edge endpoint, so RENDITION_OF uses a resolved Source subject with the planner-derived uid; (3) no proposal kind writes assessments (RETELLING_FIDELITY, CONFLICT_RELEVANCE, RESOLUTION) or derived Chunk / COVERS_LOCATOR / MENTIONS (projection jobs, read-only by design); (4) AssertionCore has no qualifiers, so qualifier strings (segment, credited-name, population, dose-basis) are in assertions.yaml only, apart from segmentKind. Node types Channel / MediaWork are the D9 proposal, not the pinned schema: this intent validates against the contract (zod) and will plan only once the proposal is pinned. Close-out 2026-10-09 (FU-03): R-43 the three RENDITION_OF rows are asserted (AssertedRecordedProperties; feed publisher org-scicomm for web page and audio, BellLabs curation agent for the YouTube join); R-30 verbatim role edge field removed, printed text in the roleText: qualifier; F-05 comment. Assertion qualifiers and the R-49 projection cache have no v1 slot; they are in assertions.yaml and in proposal rationales.
